prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1015; do not mention it.)
text:
We have been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the collision, together with a certified declarations page confirming those limits and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair and total-loss records, telematics data, claim file materials, and any statements taken from parties or witnesses. Any loss of this material may result in sanctions and will be addressed accordingly.

We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this representation and your response to the requests above.
